text_block_list.text:
After our outing,
Mejiro Bright invited me along to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here we are: the Lolita Fashion Exhibition♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this day has finally come... I've been
looking forward to the exhibition for so long~!
Trainer, is your heart prepared?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how dependable~.
Well then, let us be off♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how magnificent...!
This venue... has been modeled
after an Elizabethan-era church, hasn't it~...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~...
So this section exhibits "Elegant Lolita" and "Classical Lolita" fashion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: These two designs are inspired by royalty and nobility from the medieval to early modern periods. In other words—
choice_data_list: So it expresses that worldview, huh

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So, it's such a pity~.
If only I had worn a dress, we could have taken
some lovely photos here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: For example, sitting on a Victorian-style chair... Ahhh, how wonderful~♪
choice_data_list: There's fun to be had in joining in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ This place is so special.
I feel like I've wandered into Wonderland~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the café attached to this place
is quite popular as a sweet lolita café.
My particular recommendation is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A macaron tower~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so~! It's so adorable,
just looking at it warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Unlike chocolate or ice cream, it won't melt even if you take your sweet time admiring it with your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, shall we split it in half?
Let's recharge our energy for the next exhibit~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This is... "Gothic Lolita"!
choice_data_list: This set looks like actual ruins.
This set looks like actual ruins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, it is quite a chic and relaxing space~
Almost like a haunted house—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
"Visitor, remove the veil and awaken the coffin from its slumber."
Should I remove this veil, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, together now... Ready, and... go!
(PSSSSSSSHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My~, what quite the surprise that was.
To think smoke and a Mr. Skeleton would pop out~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding, you know?
It felt just like a scene from an adventure story, so thrilling♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a delightful event,
getting to enjoy the attractions and all.
I'd love to come here every single day~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lovely clothes, delicious sweets, and a thrilling adventure.
The day just flew by in the blink of an eye, didn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, Trainer-sama.
Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
I was able to spend a truly wondrous time~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sharing something I "love"
with someone else is truly special to me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It is truly a most mysterious thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-sama, you were the one
who knocked on the door to my world."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"What will happen once I open this door?
How will it feel to share the world inside my heart with you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I feel like I've caught a small glimpse
of that answer today~.
choice_data_list: Let's go searching for answers again sometime.
There's more to Bright's world than meets the eye...!
There's more to Bright's world than meets the eye, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I feel like I've caught a small glimpse
of that answer today~.
choice_data_list: Let's go searching for answers again sometime.
There's more to Bright's world than meets the eye...!
There's more to Bright's world than meets the eye, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There are still so many things
we haven't had the chance to talk about~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We've already talked plenty
about dolls and Lolita fashion, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, let me tell you all about the stylistic beauty
and history of antiques~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, my heart is pounding even faster than in a haunted house~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wonder~?
Even I haven't seen the bottom of my own depth, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm actually quite greedy.
I'd love to visit overseas doll shows and fashion shows, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it's Europe, the Renaissance architecture
and sculptures are simply not to be missed~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Plus, taking commemorative photos with dolls at famous sights♪
It's only going to get deeper and deeper from here~.
